reviews.body: Clean fix for the UnboundLocalError and silent message-drop bugs. The new code correctly handles both cases: when a system message is present it extracts it to the `system` field, and when absent all messages are kept. The test adequately verifies the fix, and backward compatibility is maintained by existing tests. Ready to merge.
